heading: The Library panel
text:
On a desktop, the **Library** panel runs down the left of the page and is how you
move between collections. In a narrow window it becomes its own screen, reached
by **‹ Library** above the title.

| Row | What is in it |
| --- | --- |
| **All Songs** | Everything you have not archived. |
| **Collaborative** | Songs with more than one writer. A song joins the moment it gains an invite code, so you never put anything here by hand. |
| **Projects** | Folders you make. An album, a client, a session. |
| **Archive** | Songs you have set aside. Hidden until you archive something. |

Web app:
On the web the last row is called **Archived** and is always listed.

The count beside each row is how many songs are in it.

iPhone and iPad app:
The tab remembers where
you were, so if you last looked at a project, that is where it opens next time
rather than at All Songs.

text:
Most of what looks like a bug in Lyric Genie is a control that is waiting for
something. This page is grouped by where the problem shows up.
description: The problems people actually run into, and what to do about them.

heading: Where did my work go
text:
### I signed in and my library is empty

You are almost certainly in the other account. Lyric Genie signs in with Google
or with Apple, and those are **two separate accounts** even when both use the
same email address. Songs written under one are invisible to the other.

Sign out, sign back in with the other button, and check whether your songs are
there. Nothing has been deleted.

### I recorded something and cannot find it in my song

Open the **Recordings** tab. If the recording was made from the Start tab rather
than from inside a song, it is unattached and waiting there. Use **Add to Song**
on it.

This is the most common confusion in the app and it is worth reading
[How it fits together](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/how-it-fits-together/) once to get the shape of it.

### My lyric sheet does not show the changes I made

A lyric sheet is a **frozen snapshot**, taken at the moment you created it.
Editing the song afterwards never changes a link you have already sent, which is
the point: what you sent a publisher last week still reads the way it did when
you sent it.

Make a new sheet when you want the current version. See
[Lyric sheets](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/editor/lyric-sheets/).
description: The problems people actually run into, and what to do about them.

heading: Buttons that do nothing
text:
### Perform is greyed out

The song has no lyrics yet. Perform needs something to display. Write a line and
it wakes up.

### The title suggestion button does nothing

Same cause. It reads your lyrics to suggest a title, so it needs lyrics to read.

### Nothing happens while I type, and I was expecting suggestions

In-line suggestions are **silent** without AI access. They do not interrupt you
with an upgrade screen while you are writing, which is deliberate, but it does
mean the feature simply never appears.

Check the In-line Suggestions row in **Preferences**. That is where the switch
and the upgrade prompt both live. See
[In-line suggestions](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/editor/inline-suggestions/).

### Refine Context opened the upgrade screen

Refine Context uses your AI calls. On the free plan, the upgrade screen appears
once they are used up. Everything on the AI Context sheet is still free to edit
by hand. See [Plan limits](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/reference/limits/).

heading: Wish Workshop
text:
### It asked me questions instead of writing

The song had no **AI Context**, so Wish Workshop stopped to collect some. It
needs a mood, a theme, or a reference point before it can write in your voice
rather than in nobody's.

Answer the questions once and it will not ask again for that song. You can also
fill the fields yourself from the ⋯ menu.

### It rewrote my line when I wanted new material

A selection was active. With text selected, Wish Workshop rewrites that text.
With nothing selected, it offers **Creative Spark**, which writes something new.

Tap anywhere to deselect, then open the lamp again.

### My rewritten line does not fit the melody any more

One of the two constraint toggles was turned off. Both are on by default: one
holds the syllable count, the other holds the rhyme. Turn them back on and run
it again. See [Wish Workshop](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/editor/wish-workshop/).

### It said my selection was too large

Rewrite takes up to six lines and 500 characters. Rhyme and Thesaurus are
tighter still: they want a single line or less. Shorten the selection and try
again.

### I ran out of AI calls

The free plan includes {{limit.ai.freeCalls}} calls of the larger AI features and
{{limit.ai.freeCallsLowCost}} of the lighter ones. Current numbers for both plans are
on [Plan limits](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/reference/limits/).

heading: Collaboration
text:
### My solo song suddenly has tabs

Generating an invite code makes a song collaborative straight away, before
anyone accepts it. The song grows a tab row and a Master tab at that moment.

If nobody joins, nothing else changes, and the tabs are harmless.

Web app:
On the web you can undo it. While nobody has joined, choose **Stop sharing**
from the ⋯ button on the **Collaborators** section's header and the song goes
back to being yours alone. See
[Inviting a collaborator](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/collaboration/inviting/#stop-sharing).

### My collaborator cannot see my Scratchpad notes

Working as intended. The Scratchpad belongs to you, not to the song's writers,
and it is the one place on a shared song that stays private. It says **Private
· only you can see this**, with an eye icon.

If the song was shared before scratchpads became private, notes that were in
the shared scratchpad were copied into each writer's own, so you may both see
the same old notes. Anything you add from now on is yours alone.

### Master says someone else is editing

Only one writer types in Master at a time. While someone is, the Master tab
shows a lock in their colour with their initial, and tapping in says, for
example, **Sam is editing Master · free in 12 s**.

Wait for it. The lock frees itself 30 seconds after they stop typing, or
sooner if they tap the lock to let others in. If it is you who is holding it on
another device, or a collaborator who has wandered off, the 30 seconds still
apply. **Send to Master** and Arrange on Master wait for the lock too.

On the iPhone, typing in Master needs version 2.23. In older versions Master is
read-only, and you change it by sending sections to it.

See [The Master](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/collaboration/master/#one-writer-at-a-time).

### I sent lines to Master and they went to the bottom

That is where sent lines go: the end of Master, exactly as you selected them.
Move them into place by typing in Master, or with **Arrange Master**. See
[The Master](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/collaboration/master/#sending-lines-to-master).

### Nothing was emailed to my collaborator

An invite code is never emailed. It is a **six character code** plus a share
link, and you send it however you like. The recipient enters it under
**Settings**, **Song Invite Code**. See
[Inviting a collaborator](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/collaboration/inviting/).

Web app:
The web can email an invitation, but only to someone you have written with
before, picked from **Previous collaborators**. They accept it from their
notifications.

### I can't invite anyone else

The song is full. A song can have up to eight collaborators, you included, and
invites nobody has used yet count toward that. Cancel an invite that is no
longer needed, or remove someone, to make room. See
[How many people](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/collaboration/inviting/#how-many-people).

### I'm not getting chat notifications on my iPhone

Chat pushes need version 2.22 or later of the iPhone app, and notifications
allowed for Lyric Genie in the iOS Settings app. You get one push per message,
but only one item per song in the bell, which clears once you have read the
chat. Reading the chat on the web clears the song's chat notifications on your
iPhone too. See [Notifications](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/collaboration/notifications/).

heading: Sessions
text:
[Song sessions](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/collaboration/sessions/) work on the web app and in the
iPhone app from version 2.23.

### I can't find sessions at all

Sessions are open to everyone. On the iPhone they need version 2.23 or later:
older versions have no **Live Session** in the ⋯ menu, so update from the App
Store. On the web, reload the page if you still see **Join a song** where the
**Session** circle should be.

Starting a session needs Pro, a free trial included. Joining is free while a
Pro writer is in the session.

### My collaborator can't see or hear me

iPhone and iPad app:
The iPhone app was not allowed to use the camera or microphone. Open the iOS
**Settings** app, find **Lyric Genie**, and turn on **Camera** and
**Microphone**. Then leave the session and join again.

Also check that you are not muted, in the session or from the lock screen or
Control Center.

Web app:
Your browser has blocked the camera or microphone. The session check says
**Allow the camera and microphone in your browser to be seen and heard. You can
still join.** Click the camera or lock icon in the address bar, allow both for
the site, and reload the page.

Also check that the mic and camera are on: purple in a session, not red on
the camera and mic check, and that the right **Microphone** is chosen. In a session, the arrow beside
your mic row in **Audio inputs** switches devices. On a Mac, the browser also
needs permission in **System Settings**, **Privacy & Security**, under
**Camera** and **Microphone**.

### The DAW plugin is not found (web)

Check three things: the plugin is installed, your DAW is open with the plugin
loaded on a track or bus, and Lyric Genie is open on the same computer. If you
told Chrome or Edge not to let Lyric Genie access apps on this device, turn it
back on in the site's settings. See
[If the plugin is not found](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/guides/daw-plugin/#if-the-plugin-is-not-found).

### My collaborators can't hear my DAW (web)

- **Is it shared?** Look at **Your DAW** in **Audio inputs**. If it says it is
  ready to share, click **Share**. It does not share itself while a collaborator is
  already sharing audio, or after you removed it in this session.
- **Is it muted?** Check the mute button on the row, and **Mute send** in the
  plugin window.
- **Is anything playing through it?** The plugin only sends what passes through
  the track or bus it sits on. Put it on the master bus to send the whole mix.
- **Did the sample rate change?** The session says so. Click **Share** again.

If you share computer audio instead of the plugin, turn on **Share audio** when
the browser asks what to share. Without it no sound comes through.

### There is an echo

Someone's speakers are feeding back into their microphone. Headphones fix it.
The person whose voice you hear repeated is usually not the one causing it, so
ask the others to put headphones on.

Music mode makes this much more likely, because it turns off echo
cancellation. Only use it with headphones on.

Web app:
If you share your DAW and play it through speakers, keep
[Duck mic](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/guides/daw-plugin/#duck-mic) on. It lowers your mic while the track
plays, so the track does not come through your mic as well.

### The video keeps freezing

A connection is weak. When yours is, the session lowers the quality of the
video coming in so the audio stays smooth, and full quality comes back by
itself. A collaborator whose own connection is weak shows a **Weak** label on
their video.

Turning your own camera off, and stopping a screen share, both lighten the
load. (web) On the web you can also lower **Camera quality** in the menu
beside the camera button, if it is your video that freezes for others.

### My session went quiet when a call came in (iPhone and iPad)

iPhone and iPad app:
On the iPhone a session works like a phone call, so a real phone call puts it
on hold. It picks up again when you hang up.

### My session ended by itself

Sessions left open by mistake end on their own. You leave after 10 minutes
alone in a session, and after a long quiet stretch or a very long session you
are asked **Still in the session?** first. Each person also leaves after five
hours in a session, with a warning in the last ten minutes. You can rejoin
straight away. See
[Leaving and ending](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/collaboration/sessions/#leaving-and-ending).

heading: Recording and importing
text:
### Freestyle starts recording before I am ready

That is deliberate when you launch it from the **Start** tab. To open Freestyle
without it recording, open a song and tap the microphone icon in the editor
instead.

### Transcription stopped but the recording kept going

That is the intended behaviour. Transcription needs a network connection and
recording does not, so a network problem costs you the words and not the audio.
You will see a message when it happens.

The recording is saved. You can transcribe it later when you have a connection.

### My import did nothing

Older versions failed silently on files that were too large or in an unsupported
format. Current versions tell you what went wrong. If you are on an older
version, update.

If you are on the current version and an import is refused, the message says
why. The two usual causes are a file longer than your plan allows, and a format
that is not on the [supported list](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/reference/formats/).

### I am out of recording time

The free plan holds {{limit.recording.freeTotal}} of audio in total, with each
recording capped at {{limit.recording.freePerItem}}. Deleting recordings you no longer
need frees the space back up. Pro raises the total to
{{limit.recording.proTotal}}.

### The web app says recording needs Chrome, Edge or Safari

Web app:
Your browser cannot make AAC audio, which is what Lyric Genie stores, so it
cannot record or import audio. Firefox is the usual one. Use Chrome, Edge or
Safari for that part. Recordings made on the web play on your iPhone.

iPhone and iPad app:
The web app needs Chrome, Edge or Safari to record or import audio. Firefox
cannot.

heading: Account and billing
text:
### I deleted my account and I am still being charged

Deleting your Lyric Genie account does not cancel your subscription, because the
subscription belongs to Apple rather than to us. Cancel it in **Settings**,
**Apple Account**, **Subscriptions** on your iPhone.

See [Deleting your account](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/account/deleting/).

### Sign in is not working

Sign in problems now show a message explaining what failed. If you dismissed it
or are on an older version, the usual causes are no network connection, or
cancelling the Apple or Google sheet before it finished.

Web app:
On the web, sign-in happens in a small pop-up window. If nothing appeared, your
browser blocked it, so allow pop-ups for the site and try again.

text:

heading: Songs and collaborators
text:
### A song called "… (Conflict copy)" appeared

The same lines were changed in two different ways on two devices at once. Your
song keeps one version, and the other edits are in the copy, linked from a
banner in the song. Take what you need from it and delete it.

### Where did the Mailbox go

Lines a collaborator sends you now arrive as cards in the song's
[chat](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/collaboration/chat/), from version 2.22 of the iPhone app. See
[Sending lines to a collaborator](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/collaboration/sending/).

### I can't find something from weeks ago

On the web, press **⌘K** (Ctrl+K on Windows). [Search](https://lyricgenie.app/docs/editor/search/) looks
through every song, every writer's lyrics, notes, chat, recordings and concepts.
